secoes.corpo:
The site is structured to be 100% operable without a mouse. For quick navigation, we provide the following commands:

Tab:
Moves focus sequentially between interactive elements (links, buttons, calculator inputs).

Shift + Tab:
Returns focus to the previous element.

Enter / Space:
Activates the button, executes the calculation, or opens the focused link.

Esc (Escape):
Closes open menus, modal windows, or selection boxes instantly.

Arrow Keys:
Used to navigate within form fields, tabs, or dropdown lists.

textoCompleto:
Privacy and Data Use Policy

Transparency and Protection

Full commitment to the security of your information. Learn how we collect, protect, and use data in compliance with the LGPD.

1. Informational Framework
All provisions of this Privacy Policy are extremely important for our relationship with you. To facilitate your reading, we have prepared the table below with the main terms you should be aware of.

2. Presentations
2.1. What data does this document refer to?
This Policy concerns information that may identify or allow the identification of a natural person, such as name, CPF, phone number, email, or address.

3. How do we obtain (collect) your data?
Some data may be collected when you provide it directly to us or through your interactions with the Site.

Data provided by you:
Information submitted when filling out registration forms, contests, or campaigns (name, phone, email, etc.).

Data collected automatically:
IP addresses, access time and date, cookies, geolocation, device screen information, and page interactions.

Cookies are small files stored in your browser that help personalize your access. You can change or disable cookies by adjusting your browser settings.

4. Purpose of data processing
We process your personal data primarily to enable your interaction with the Site, as well as your registration. Purposes include:

Enable your registration on the Site and participation in campaigns;

Send advertising or institutional messages (push, SMS, email);

Identification and prevention of potential security threats or fraud;

Regular exercise of company rights, including in legal proceedings;

Analytics - recognition of usage profiles to generate statistical data for Site improvement.

5. Data sharing and transfer
We may share personal data with business partners and suppliers (such as agencies, logistics and technology operators) essential for the operation of the site.

International Transfers:
Your data may be processed by servers located abroad. In such cases, we ensure that the transfer occurs under adequate data protection standards, through standard contractual clauses or global standards equivalent to the LGPD.

Retention:
We will retain your data only for the period necessary to serve the purpose of processing or to comply with applicable legal obligations.

6. Advertising and Google AdSense
To finance the maintenance of this Site and keep access to the tools completely free for the nursing community, we display ads from partners. Consequently, this Policy incorporates the requirements of our advertising partners, especially
Google AdSense
.

Data Collection and Use by Google:
Our site uses Google services that collect and use data for ad delivery and analytics. This includes your IP address, browser information, and interactions.

Third-Party Cookies:
Third parties, including Google, may place and read cookies in browsers or use web beacons to collect information, enabling the delivery of ads based on previous visits.

Ad Personalization:
Google may use the collected information to personalize the ads you see, based on your interests.

Mandatory Disclosure about Google's Use of Data:

To fulfill our transparency obligation, we provide the official Google link explaining how your information is used by advertising partners:

7. Your Rights (Data Subject)
To exercise your rights, contact us via email at
ciadeenfermagem@gmail.com
.

Digital Inclusion

Accessibility Policy
We recognize the importance of digital accessibility. We are committed to providing an inclusive experience for all users, without exception.

1. Conformance Level
This site is designed to comply with the
Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, Level AA
. We also proactively apply several recommended practices from Level AAA, aiming to provide maximum inclusion. Our efforts include high color contrast, native screen reader support, and perceptible visual focus control.

2. Implemented Accessibility Features
Accessibility Bar:
Dynamic controls for font size, contrast inversion, and text spacing.

Inclusive Typography:
Option to activate the
OpenDyslexic
font, specially designed for users with dyslexia.

Skip Links:
Hidden "Skip to main content" links at the top of the page, facilitating keyboard navigation.

Auditory Feedback (ARIA):
Heavy use of
aria-live
,
aria-hidden
e
role
attributes to ensure assistive technologies fully understand the calculators and dynamic menus.

Structural Semantics:
Clean hierarchical HTML organization (H1 to H6 tags, main, nav, article), essential for correct systemic reading.

3. Keyboard Shortcuts and Systemic Navigation
The site is structured to be 100% operable without a mouse. For quick navigation, we provide the following commands:

Tab:
Moves focus sequentially between interactive elements (links, buttons, calculator inputs).

Shift + Tab:
Returns focus to the previous element.

Enter / Space:
Activates the button, executes the calculation, or opens the focused link.

Esc (Escape):
Closes open menus, modal windows, or selection boxes instantly.

Arrow Keys:
Used to navigate within form fields, tabs, or dropdown lists.

4. Screen Reader Compatibility
We regularly validate our interface with the most widely used assistive technologies on the market:

NVDA
(Windows)

JAWS
(Windows)

TalkBack
(Android devices)

VoiceOver
(iOS and macOS devices)

5. Ongoing Statement and Contact
Accessibility is an ongoing journey. We are constantly training our team and improving our codes. If you encounter any accessibility barrier that prevents you from using one of our calculators or content, please let us know so we can fix it immediately:

Direct email for support: ciadeenfermagem@gmail.com

Commitment to Digital Inclusion
